items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Buddy didn't play fast as we were down here. But Buddy used to play slow pieces...

ctx.x: Until that bebop business came out then. That's right. But yet I listen to some of those old Red Island records from 29 or so, and you hear him doing some of those funny changes. Mm-hmm. Yeah. So I wonder, maybe he picked that up in New York. But Buddy never did that kind of stuff, huh? Buddy Petitti ever.

Buddy didn't play fast as we were down here. But Buddy used to play slow pieces and make all kinds of funny chords in them. That's the truth. If he played in B flat, he'd come up with some kind of, B flat on his trumpet, he'd come up with some kind of A flat, B natural, C sharp, and E natural. Look, them all kinds of funny chords, you know. All that was funny stuff, you know.
